name: Language Failover
description: Per-user audio and subtitle language priority with fallback. Automatically selects the best audio and subtitle tracks based on an ordered language preference list, with per-series overrides.
overview: Multi-language fallback for audio and subtitles

versions.changelog:
A patch for 1.2.0.0: the language dropdowns on the configuration page were unreadable.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **Dropdown lists were white-on-white.** On a dark Jellyfin theme, opening the user picker or any language selector showed a light popup with white text — every entry invisible except the one under the cursor. The popup is drawn by the browser in its own light/dark scheme, while the text colour was still being taken from the Jellyfin theme; the two are now read as a pair so they can never disagree. The series search results panel had the same latent problem and was fixed with it.

## 🔧 Under the hood

- The release workflow now refuses to publish from a tag with no release note, instead of silently falling back to the last commit message. That fallback is why **1.2.0.0 appears in the catalogue as *"Merge branch 'develop'"*** — its real release notes are on the [GitHub releases page](https://github.com/Hightmar/jellyfin-langage-failover/releases).

## ⬆️ Upgrading

Straight upgrade from 1.2.0.0 — no configuration changes. If you are coming from 1.1.x, read the 1.2.0.0 notes first: subtitle selection changed there. Server compatibility is unchanged (**Jellyfin 10.11.x**).
